fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' {{tip|dash|jumps}} to the target location. Upon landing, she deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slows}} them by 40% for 2 seconds.
fields.description2: Scoring an enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}} or detonating ''{{ai|Explosive Charge|Tristana}}'' at maximum stacks on a champion will reset ''Rocket Jump's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
fields.description3: '''''Tristana''' can cast any of her [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''
